creation.geometry_source: Normal public PointerInput -> Runtime BrushSession; never construct canonical geometry in JS
creation.timestamps: Monotonic; preserve trace relative creation times with a fixed safe native timestamp origin. Later gestures continue that clock; keep integer nanoseconds lossless.
creation.snapshot_freeze: Baseline worker captures the initial 19-object canonical snapshot with public existing captureSnapshot before its first erase; save SHA and metadata before production mutation. All final candidate passes restore the same bytes. No UI import/export capability.

sustained_followup.point_formula: gesture g=0..2, i=0..180: x=145+48*g+10*sin(0.15*i), y=355+12*g+0.35*i. Up repeats i=180; next Down dispatched in same DOM task after Up.
sustained_followup.cancel: Add a separate 60-move cancel after the six commits; no mutation. Then Undo/Redo once; exactly six erase Operations plus two History Operations.

hold_control.use: Qualification only, separate from uninterrupted primary measurements

input_proof: Before mutation, independently verify planned active ROIs intersect real surviving pigment after earlier masks on the baseline snapshot. Use the pinned old exact/uncached reference, never select points or lower commit counts from candidate output. A dry construction error is a package/input blocker, not permission to adapt.
